proof_body:
by
  intro T _ s a n
  have hint : ∀ k ∈ s, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : AddCircle T => a k * fourier k x) AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
    intro k _
    exact ((map_continuous (fourier k)).const_smul (a k)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have h := congrFun (fourierCoeff.sum s (fun k (x : AddCircle T) => a k * fourier k x) hint) n
  have e : (∑ i ∈ s, fun x : AddCircle T => a i * fourier i x) = fun x : AddCircle T => ∑ k ∈ s, a k * fourier k x := by
    funext x; simp
  rw [e] at h
  rw [h, Finset.sum_apply]
  have hk : ∀ k ∈ s, fourierCoeff (fun x : AddCircle T => a k * fourier k x) n = if k = n then a n else 0 := by
    intro k _
    rw [fourierCoeff.const_mul, fourierCoeff_fourier]
    by_cases hkn : k = n
    · subst hkn; simp
    · simp [Pi.single_apply, Ne.symm hkn, hkn]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hk, Finset.sum_ite_eq' s n]
target_source: ∀ (T : ℝ) [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) (n : ℤ), fourierCoeff (fun x : AddCircle T => ∑ k ∈ s, a k * fourier k x) n = if n ∈ s then a n else 0
